newsitem.title: UK: Russian economic roadshows to start June 11.
newsitem.headline: Russian economic roadshows to start June 11.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance of the Russian Federation said in a statement on Wednesday its economic roadshows would start in Seoul on June 11.
A delegation will be led by Mikhail Kasyanov, Deputy Minister of Finance and presentations will end in New York on June 18, the statement said.
The full programme is as follows:
Russian officials said on Tuesday that it would launch a dollar Eurobond in the second half of June.
The deal will have a maturity of at least seven years.
Russia said J.P. Morgan and SBC Warburg would lead manage the deal. --Denise Manning, London newsroom, +44 171 542 7658
